description: Synthetic coding-memory examples with manually labeled Indonesian-English retrieval queries. Filler records are generated deterministically.

memories.title: Refresh expired access credentials
memories.content: When a login session expires, exchange the refresh token for a new access token and retry the protected request once.

memories.title: Batalkan transaksi pembayaran gagal
memories.content: Jika payment gateway menolak pembayaran, lakukan rollback transaksi database agar pesanan tidak tersimpan sebagian.

memories.title: Git branch naming convention
memories.content: Name feature branches feature/short-topic and bug fixes fix/short-topic so the team can identify intent in review.

memories.title: Penyimpanan rahasia produksi
memories.content: Simpan API key produksi di secret manager; jangan memasukkannya ke repository, berkas .env contoh, atau log aplikasi.

memories.title: Resolve dashboard hydration mismatch
memories.content: Render the same initial data on the server and client; delay browser-only timestamps until after hydration.

memories.title: Sinkronisasi cache memori Notion
memories.content: Setelah perubahan Notion, bangun ulang indeks SQLite FTS5 sebelum menggunakan pencarian semantic atau hybrid.

memories.title: Make time-dependent tests deterministic
memories.content: Inject a clock into code under test instead of sleeping, then assert behavior at a controlled timestamp.

memories.title: Tangani batas laju API
memories.content: Saat server mengembalikan HTTP 429, hormati Retry-After dan jadwalkan ulang permintaan dengan backoff terbatas.

memories.title: Preserve manual Obsidian edits
memories.content: When the Markdown mirror changes locally, keep the edited note and write a separate conflict copy of the authoritative Notion version.

memories.title: Migrasi skema tanpa downtime
memories.content: Tambahkan kolom baru lebih dulu, jalankan backfill, lalu aktifkan pembacaan baru sebelum menghapus kolom lama.

memories.title: Retrieve relevant passages from long notes
memories.content: Split large memory documents into overlapping chunks and return a short matching excerpt with the source ID.

memories.title: Pulihkan deploy melalui Git
memories.content: Jika rilis gagal, kembalikan commit deploy sebelumnya dan jalankan pemeriksaan kesehatan sebelum membuka trafik lagi.
